definition: Wes McKinney is an American software developer and businessman.
details: Created the Python pandas library for data manipulation and co-created Apache Arrow for high-performance columnar in-memory analytics. He is the creator and "Benevolent Dictator for Life" (BDFL) of the open-source pandas package for data analysis in the Python programming language, and has also authored three versions of the reference book Python for Data Analysis. He is also the creator of Apache Arrow, a cross-language development platform for in-memory data, and Ibis, a unified Python dataframe API. He was the CEO and founder of technology startup Datapad.

explainer.lead: Wes McKinney is an American software developer and businessman.
explainer.knownFor: Notable works include Pandas and Python for data analysis.

contributions.name: He founded Ursa Labs, which, in 2021, became part of Voltron Data.
He went on leave from Duke in the summer of 2011 to devote more time to developing Pandas, culminating in the writing of Python for Data Analysis in 2012.
McKinney co-founded Datapad with Chang She in January 2013, with McKinney as CEO.

timeline.what: Bachelor of Science, Massachusetts Institute of Technology
In 2007, McKinney graduated from Massachusetts Institute of Technology with a BS in Mathematics.
From 2007 to 2010, McKinney researched global macro and credit trading strategies at AQR Capital Management.
McKinney made the pandas project public in 2009.
In 2010, McKinney began a PhD program in Statistics at Duke University.
